title: Retail Installment Contracts Payoff Desk Reference: Issuing a Payoff Statement
content:
**Policy entry.** This rule fixes the payoff figure and the good-through date a payoff statement quotes for a contract under Retail Installment Contracts whose status is active, repossessed or charged off. A statement moves no balance.

**When the figure is fixed.** A payoff statement's figure is fixed only after each returned payment on the contract that owes a returned-payment fee carries it.

Restated on the contract's records: while a returned payment that owes a returned-payment fee has no returned-payment fee linked to it, the statement figure is not yet fixed.

## Capability

`issue_payoff_quote_f4f38627` issues a payoff statement on a borrower's retail installment contract. One call records a payoff quote dated today stating the payoff figure and the last date that figure is good through; no balance, fee or due date on the contract changes. The borrower can be given the figure and the good-through date shown on the receipt, which means the statement is on file. The tool records the figure and date it is given; it does not work them out.

## How it is invoked

An agent-side tool: the representative unlocks `issue_payoff_quote_f4f38627` and calls it.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `contract_id` | the contract reference number of the retail installment contract the statement is for, as returned by the contract lookup | text identifier |
| `quote_good_through_date` | the last date the quoted figure pays the contract in full | YYYY-MM-DD, a calendar date with no time or time zone; never empty for a statement |
| `quoted_payoff_usd` | the payoff figure stated | USD, 2 decimal places; 0.00 when not applicable; stored rounded half-up to the cent exactly as passed |

## Return

A receipt rendered as text with `servicing_event_id` (reference of the payoff statement record), `contract_id`, `effective_date` (YYYY-MM-DD quote date), `quote_good_through_date` (YYYY-MM-DD), `quoted_payoff_usd` (the figure stated, 2 decimal places) and `status`, the text issued, meaning the statement is on file.

**Q&A.** *Which date is the quote date?* The day the statement is issued; the record carries it as its effective date.
